digest.component_or_area: dependency management and toolchain (ruff, mypy, lockfile)
propositions: Dependabot PR #131 requires re-authoring as a Gerrit change to land on main because GitHub is a read-only mirror that rejects direct merges.
The lockfile upgrade bumps ruff and mypy (lint and typecheck gates) to new versions that may surface additional findings requiring code fixes rather than suppressions.

Newer resolution resolves botocore to 1.43.75, genai-prices to 0.1.4, and json-repair to 0.63.3 (further than PR's pins) while mypy reaches 2.3.1 and ruff reaches 0.16.3, with all gates passing and zero code changes needed.
Gerrit change 1943 merged successfully with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, and dependabot auto-closed PR #131 when the mirror synced the commit.
Complexity baseline ratchet remained at stale=0 new=0 under ruff 0.16.3, confirming no tool-version scoring drift on existing baselined functions.
